info.name: ViewSet for managing the current broker user's own AI customizations.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

items.docs:
Every broker user can fully manage their own personalizations; the
``broker_pk`` in the URL is the user's agency and is validated for access,
but customizations are always scoped to ``request.user.broker_user``.
